note: the stock page always ran restart_time;restart_leds;restart_firewall plus the conditional parts; Reaper_System builds the script per change: restart_time (zone, DST, NTP, reboot schedule), restart_dnsmasq (ntpd_enable), restart_sshd (SSH), restart_leds (LEDs, buttons), restart_usb_idle (USB idle), restart_httpd[;restart_ftpd] (protocol, ports, WAN access), restart_firewall (WAN access, SSH exposure, access list, WAN-down redirect, NTP intercept), pwrsave, pagecache_ratio, reboot (usb_usb3); saveNvram alone when nothing needs a restart
